result.reason: The operative language adequately provides the preferred six-month transition period at then-current rates, but it does not itself require return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days or certified deletion thereafter. The cross-reference to Sections 11.2 and 11.3 could satisfy those elements only if those sections expressly contain them; the margin comment cannot cure their absence from the supplied language. Otherwise, the changes are targeted and professionally drafted.
